## Aggregates

Each aggregate root with the entities and enums it owns, and how they relate.

### Order

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Order {
        <<aggregate>>
        String orderId
        OrderStatus status
        String customerId
        String customerEmail
        String paymentMethodId
        OrderItem[] items
        ShippingAddress shippingAddress
        BigDecimal totalAmount
        String currency
        Instant createdAt
        Instant confirmedAt
        Instant cancelledAt
        String cancellationReason
    }
    class OrderItem {
        <<embedded>>
        String sku
        Integer quantity
        BigDecimal unitPrice
    }
    class ShippingAddress {
        <<embedded>>
        String name
        String line1
        String line2
        String city
        String region
        String postalCode
        String country
    }
    class OrderStatus {
        <<enumeration>>
        CREATED
        CONFIRMED
        CANCELLED
    }
    Order --> OrderStatus : status
    Order *-- "*" OrderItem : items
    Order *-- ShippingAddress : shippingAddress
```

#### Lifecycle

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CREATED : startOrderCheckout
    CREATED --> CONFIRMED : confirmOrder
    CREATED --> CANCELLED : cancelOrder
    CONFIRMED --> CANCELLED : cancelOrder
    CANCELLED --> [*]
```

Field `status`, initial `CREATED`.
